title: Vandermonde point in the binary extension field
statement: Let an executable Vandermonde input have output dimension $n$, and put $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. For each index $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, its associated point in the degree-$\ell$ Galois field over $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the image, under the field equivalence determined by the chosen irreducible polynomial, of the encoded binary-vector point associated with $j$.
hypotheses_covered: Input has an independence order $k$ with $1\le k\le n$
